sections.title: An evening *on Center Street*

image.alt: The Brinkley’s dining room, with blue upholstered chairs and a wine wall

body: Brinkley’s Chop House serves an exceptional selection of steaks, seafood and chops on Center Street in North Augusta, using the best ingredients.
In 2026, Brinkley’s was named one of the Best of North Augusta, the North Augusta’s Choice awards of the Post and Courier’s North Augusta Star.

sections.title: Book *a private event*
sections.intro: We’d love to host your next event.

items.title: Pick a date
items.text: Tell us the day, and the start and end time.

items.title: Share the details
items.text: The type of event, how many guests, and anything else we should know.

items.title: We’ll be in touch
items.text: Send the request, and we’ll be in touch soon.

items.a: Yes. Call (803) 599-5097, or send a request with the form below.
Valet parking is available, and Brinkley’s validates it.
Yes, e-gift cards are sold online.

items.q: Can you host a private event?
items.a: Yes. Send the date, times, type of event and number of guests, and we’ll be in touch.
Monday to Friday from 4 pm to 10 pm, Saturday from noon to 10 pm, and Sunday from noon to 9 pm.

sections.title: Reserve your table
sections.text: Dinner from 4 pm on weekdays, and from noon on weekends.
